body.objective: Students will be able to name countries, capitals and transport.
body.iCan: I can name countries, capitals and transport.
successCriteria: I can name Spanish-speaking countries and their capitals
I can talk about ways to travel
I can say where I want to travel and how
body.hook: You could fly from Calgary to Mexico City in about five hours. From there, Spanish could take you to Lima, Bogotá, Buenos Aires or Madrid. Knowing the names of countries, capitals and ways to travel is the first step to planning a trip in Spanish.

vocabulary.term: en avión / en tren / en autobús / en coche
vocabulary.definition: By plane / by train / by bus / by car.
How are you going to get to…?

study.title: ¡Vamos de viaje!
study.question: How do I talk about travel in Spanish?
study.passage:
Countries and capitals: México: Ciudad de México · España: Madrid · Argentina: Buenos Aires · Colombia: Bogotá · Perú: Lima · Chile: Santiago · Cuba: La Habana · Costa Rica: San José.
Transport: en avión (plane), en tren (train), en autobús (bus), en coche (car; "en carro" in much of Latin America), en barco (boat), en bicicleta (bike), a pie (on foot).
Dialogue:
Valentina: ¿Adónde quieres viajar?
Samuel: Quiero ir a Perú. Quiero visitar Machu Picchu.
Valentina: ¡Qué bueno! ¿Cómo vas a viajar?
Samuel: Voy a viajar en avión a Lima. Después, voy en tren a Cusco. ¿Y tú?
Valentina: Quiero ir a España. Voy a visitar Madrid y Barcelona.
Samuel: ¿Vas en avión?
Valentina: Sí, y en España voy a viajar en tren porque es rápido.
English support: ¿Adónde quieres viajar? = Where do you want to travel? ¡Qué bueno! = How great! Voy a viajar = I am going to travel. Después = after that. porque es rápido = because it is fast.
Activity: Plan a dream trip to one Spanish-speaking country: the capital, one place to visit and how you'll travel. Present it in three sentences.
study.source: Original dialogue written for this lesson.
steps: Read the dialogue with a partner
Match countries to capitals on a map
Present your trip in three sentences
discussion: Where does Samuel want to go, and how will he travel?
Why will Valentina take the train in Spain?

How do you say "by car" in Spain and in much of Latin America?
study.product: Write a travel plan (6–8 sentences) for a trip to one Spanish-speaking country: where you will go, the capital, what you will see, how you will travel and why.
